dialogues.speaker: Quemitl
dialogues.text: I want to play the Asha Speedrun, but it looks tough... I guess it's a good thing they're not ready yet.

dialogues.speaker: Quemitl
dialogues.text: Yeah! It's not that I'm scared or anything! I'm just unlucky!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So when it is ready, you'll be ready too?

dialogues.speaker: Quemitl
dialogues.text: Umm... Well, it looks kinda tricky... I'm not sure how it works...

dialogues.speaker: Quemitl
dialogues.text: #Really? You can? Thanks, {M#Mister}{F#Missy}! I'll be waiting to take your lead!

dialogues.speaker: Quemitl
dialogues.text: #Whoa... I watched you clear the course back there, {M#Mister}{F#Missy}! You're so awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can be just as awesome.

dialogues.speaker: Quemitl
dialogues.text: Umm... Well, I've kinda got two left feet, but I'll try my best...!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you been to see a podiatrist?

dialogues.speaker: Quemitl
dialogues.text: Oh, no, I didn't mean that literally. Though when the Abyss invaded, I did break my legs while running away. The doctors fixed me back up, but I just haven't been as agile since.

dialogues.speaker: Quemitl
dialogues.text: My mom fell while fighting the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Quemitl
dialogues.text: Her name's Yohuana. Even though not many people remember her, I know she's the greatest warrior around. She protected my dad, and she protected me.

dialogues.speaker: Quemitl
dialogues.text: My dad's called Jayubal. He told me he wanted to relax, so he's probably taking a walk somewhere around here. Best not to bother him.
